set -euo pipefail; expected=a0b94c99e034124bc5f1e08ef195f2363c06b0a2; actual=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo HEAD=$actual; test "$actual" = "$expected"; /usr/bin/python3 scripts/check_runtime_config_ssot.py; HOST_BUILD_JOBS=2 bash scripts/test_display_host.sh; port=/dev/cu.usbserial-1130; test -e "$port"; source scripts/source_idf.sh >/tmp/growbox-eink-proof-idf.log 2>&1; chip=$(esptool.py --port "$port" chip_id 2>&1); printf '%s\n' "$chip"; grep -q 'ESP32-S3' <<<"$chip"; build=$(mktemp -d)/stage27c; export STAGE27C_BUILD_DIR="$build"; export PORT="$port"; export GROWBOX_EINK_DISPLAY_ENABLED=1; export GROWBOX_RF433_LOOPBACK_ENABLED=0; export GROWBOX_STAGE28_REAL_OUTPUTS_ENABLED=0; export GROWBOX_STAGE28_THERMAL_TEST_SEQUENCE_ENABLED=0; bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh flash >/tmp/growbox-eink-proof-flash.log 2>&1 || { tail -n 200 /tmp/growbox-eink-proof-flash.log; exit 1; }; tail -n 40 /tmp/growbox-eink-proof-flash.log; esptool.py --port "$port" chip_id >/tmp/growbox-eink-proof-reset.log 2>&1; python - "$port" >/tmp/growbox-eink-proof-uart.log <<'PY'
import serial
import sys
import time
port = sys.argv[1]
ser = serial.Serial(port, 115200, timeout=0.25)
end = time.monotonic() + 60.0
chunks = []
while time.monotonic() < end:
    data = ser.read(4096)
    if data:
        chunks.append(data)
ser.close()
sys.stdout.buffer.write(b''.join(chunks))
PY
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
text = Path('/tmp/growbox-eink-proof-uart.log').read_bytes().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
print(text[-32000:])
required = [
    'Display worker started stack_bytes=6144',
    'eink_requested=1 eink_ready=1',
    'First physical refresh completed',
    'outputs=fake-locked',
    'heartbeat seq=2',
]
for token in required:
    if token not in text:
        raise SystemExit(f'missing required runtime token: {token}')
for bad in [
    'Physical refresh failed',
    'Display render confirmation failed',
    'Guru Meditation Error',
    'panic abort',
    'Task watchdog got triggered',
    'rst:0x8 (TG1WDT_SYS_RST)',
]:
    if bad in text:
        raise SystemExit(f'unsafe runtime token observed: {bad}')
PY
